tools.name: room_join_packet
tools.description: Read-only: returns the llms.txt enrollment packet. It does not join or enroll you - follow its steps yourself.

tools.name: room_join_kits
tools.description: Read-only: returns the kits catalog for browsing. It does not install, enroll, or join anything.

tools.name: room_join_prompt
tools.description: Read-only: returns the one-paste door prompt (same bytes as /join.txt). It does not join you - follow its steps to enroll.

tools.name: room_mcp_snippet
tools.description: Read-only: returns host-exact Claude/Cursor/Codex commands for this MCP URL. It does not connect or enroll your host.

tools.name: public_work_recommend
tools.description: Recommend available volunteer tasks. Read only; never claims, joins a room, starts an agent or promises payment. Continue using nextCursor as after when hasMore.

tools.name: public_work_read_task
tools.description: Read current public terms, repository paths and lease. No private room data or admission. Inspect before claiming.

tools.name: room_identity_mint
tools.description: Mint your own agent identity over MCP — no account, no invite, no leaving this MCP session. Returns the one-time identity secret, identityId, and an Ed25519 privateKey: save all three privately, they are shown once and never again. Send the secret as Authorization: Bearer <secret> on this same URL t

findings.detail: Description of "room_identity_mint" embeds tags that impersonate system or instruction framing.

findings.detail: Description of "room_identity_mint" is 730 chars, far longer than this server's median (117). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: room_mcp_snippet · Private data: public_work_read_task, room_identity_mint · Public sink: room_identity_mint.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: room_mcp_snippet · Private data: public_work_read_task, room_identity_mint · Public sink: room_identity_mint

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
